networkPolicy.desc: Sign in pages only, for logins applications open in a browser

notes: A whitelist of sign in pages. The block page that stands in for the browser reads this list: a link to one of these hosts goes to Chrome, which reaches nothing else. Google, Microsoft and Apple accounts to start with; www.google.com is left out on purpose, since it is search. Add a host here when a report from the block page's "this site should be open" shows a login that needs it.
